locked_text_pilot_architecture.backbone_training_data: 2wiki_clean + musique_clean TRAIN only; dataset-agnostic (no dataset ID); directly applicable to any assembled target substrate for ZERO_SHOT

l2_corpus_c11a_substrate_present.note: The exact C7b/C8c/C11a input format (data/l2_corpus/<ds>/<split>/ with the 5 aligned expert score arrays + expert_meta.npz) exists ONLY for the DEV pair. Targets have raw ingredients (cached reps, top200, graph, NER) but NO assembled substrate yet.

splits._legend: counts from ukb_storage/<ds>/gte_qwen/query_ids_all.json split_indices. TEST is LOCKED for every dataset incl. the DEV pair and is never inspected in G1.

squad_clean.val_source: queries_all.npy[val_idx] (legitimate split; no synthetic dev needed)

webqsp.note: tiny; build_l2_corpus currently special-cases webqsp to split=all — must be switched to the train/val/test indices for G1

metaqa.hops: per-query hop label present (hops in query_ids_all + canonical metaqa_{1,2,3}hop dirs) — enables 1/2/3-hop breakdown

_legend.AVAILABLE: assembled expert arrays already on disk (l2_corpus)
_legend.REBUILDABLE_WITH_FROZEN_METHOD: a frozen, dataset-agnostic method + all required inputs exist; only a build step is needed (no new learning on the target)
_legend.REBUILDABLE_PENDING_UNIVERSAL_HEAD: frozen TRAINER exists and a universal checkpoint could be produced by the SAME frozen method used for the universal offset head, but NO universal checkpoint is on disk yet; a per-dataset head would be target-specific fitting (forbidden for a frozen upstream expert) — DECISION REQUIRED
_legend.NOT_MEANINGFUL: expert semantics invalid for this dataset
_legend.MEANINGFUL_DIFFERENT_SUBSTRATE: expert is meaningful but its underlying substrate differs from text (flagged, not forced)

Dense.method: cosine over cached gte_qwen nodes vs query; build_l2_corpus.py; needs dense_top200_all.npy + nodes.npy + alignment gate

Offset.method: UNIVERSAL offset head (src/experiments/l1_universal_head; OffsetHead in the shared frozen space) — ONE head trained on the broad-6 mix, applied to each corpus WITHOUT refit (already evaluated on all 6 in results/L2/e2e_full6_universal_gte_qwen.json)
Offset.2wiki_clean: AVAILABLE (dev substrate used the PER-DATASET offset head _heads/2wiki_clean_offset_cp50.pt)
Offset.CAVEAT: The C11a DEV substrate used PER-DATASET offset heads; targets must use the UNIVERSAL offset head (per-dataset heads absent, and training one would be target-specific fitting). This is a legitimate frozen method but introduces an offset-feature DISTRIBUTION SHIFT that the ZERO-SHOT FEATURE COMPATIBILITY step must measure and report.

Mixture.method: MixtureHead (mlpT, K directions) — same l1_universal_head trainer as offset (kind='mix')
Mixture.GAP: Only PER-DATASET mixture heads (2wiki/musique) exist. No universal mixture checkpoint on disk. A universal mixture head IS producible by the identical frozen method that made the universal offset head (train once on the broad-6 mix, apply without refit) — mirror of Offset. That is the consistent, non-inventing path but requires ONE training run and is a substrate-defining choice. DECISION REQUIRED before assembling any target substrate (this feature is part of the C11a input interface and cannot be dropped without changing the interface).

Masked-Relation.method: mask = title-mention topology from graph.pt / ner_edges_w_df25.pkl (encoder-independent, present all targets); relation_qwen_score = cos(gte-Qwen2(query), gte-Qwen2(connecting-sentence)) — requires a gte-Qwen2 sentence ENCODE (Modal GPU) of the connecting sentences
Masked-Relation.squad_clean: REBUILDABLE_WITH_FROZEN_METHOD (graph+NER present; needs Qwen sentence encode; relsig_feats_squad_clean.pt exists but may be capped/stale — validate before reuse)
Masked-Relation.webqsp: MEANINGFUL_DIFFERENT_SUBSTRATE (KB: relation is native typed graph edges, not NL connecting sentences — mask trivially rich, but the Qwen-sentence score semantics differ from text; report as substrate difference, do not force text semantics)
Masked-Relation.cost: Modal gte-Qwen2 encode of connecting sentences (heavy for hotpot/metaqa); relsig_feats_*.pt may shortcut but need validation

kb_path_graph_signal.note: Per spec: report availability but DO NOT add Path/graph to C11a in G1. Reserved. If KB transfer fails specifically because the expert substrate lacks relation/path structure, that is the reported failure mechanism (MISSING_RELATIONAL_STRUCTURE) — not patched during G1.

webqsp.path_signal: AVAILABLE from frozen infra (graph traversal / relsig)

backbone_status.C7b: frozen soft-archetype fusion, fit on 2wiki+musique; dataset-agnostic; applied unchanged
backbone_status.C8c: frozen XGBRanker reranker (C8c_reranker_fulltrain.joblib + refit-on-full-train path); dataset-agnostic
backbone_status.C11a: frozen interaction MLP _ctrl/C11_models.joblib (VAL-validated final text policy); ZERO_SHOT applies these exact weights + ORIGINAL train E-standardization (emean/estd) + original top-20 policy; REFIT_C11a retrains SAME arch/hparams on target TRAIN only, selecting on target VAL
backbone_status.E_standardization_rule: ZERO_SHOT must standardize the 18 compact evidence features with the ORIGINAL 2wiki+musique TRAIN emean/estd (saved in the model joblib) — never target VAL/TEST statistics

build_plan_order: 0. DECISION: universal mixture head (close the Mixture gap the same frozen way as the universal offset head) OR alternative — required before any target substrate assembly
1. TEXT targets (squad, hotpot): build_l2_corpus (Dense+SPLADE scope) -> splade_scope cache -> universal offset+mixture scores -> relation mask + Qwen sentence encode -> expert_meta.npz

2. ZERO-SHOT FEATURE COMPATIBILITY: compare target vs 2wiki/musique distributions (query/candidate emb norms, expert ranks, RRF contribs, C8c scores, C11 evidence) BEFORE applying zero-shot C11a; original-train standardization only
3. ZERO_SHOT_C11A + REFIT_C11A per target with baselines (frozen dataset baseline, C8c, zero-shot C11a, refit C11a)
4. KB targets (webqsp, metaqa): audit representation mismatch first (candidate = entity/relation/path/node vs passage); same interface; MetaQA hop breakdown + conditional-on-coverage ceiling
gating_decisions_surfaced: MIXTURE_UNIVERSAL_HEAD: build a single universal mixture head (mirror of universal offset) to keep the C11a 5-expert interface intact on targets? (recommended; alternative = interface change, disallowed).
RELATION_ENCODE: reuse relsig_feats_*.pt (fast, may be capped/stale) vs fresh gte-Qwen2 connecting-sentence encode on Modal (canonical, heavy).

KB_RELATION_SEMANTICS: how to define the Masked-Relation feature on KB where edges are typed (not NL sentences) — keep text-Qwen semantics (measures transfer honestly) vs native-edge score (changes the expert).
no_test_leakage: 2wiki/musique TEST NOT inspected. Targets use TRAIN/VAL (legitimate split_indices) only. All TEST splits remain locked.
AUDIT_ONLY: No substrate was built, no head trained, no C11a run in this step. This manifest is the gating deliverable before any build.
